maria: quick sync — want to tighten the scheduler<>adapter boundary so adapters can prefetch without importing scheduler logic. short sketch below.

leo: yes please. main risks are leaks and missed revokes.

anna: sketch?

maria: AcquireLease -> returns tiny lease {id, deadline_ms, est_credits, warmup_token_ref}. adapter Reserve(id) when it builds a microbatch, Release(id) when done. Revocations are server-streamed.

leo: keep lease tiny. warmup_token_ref should be a pointer to hotstore entry, not a blob.

anna: provisional credits? how do we avoid double-charge on packing?

maria: provisional credits tracked in ephemeral ledger; Confirm(prov_id, final_cost) at dispatch reconciles. TTL + reconciler to avoid leaks.

infra-bot: NOTE: created issue #INF-3122 "adapter-lease-handshake" (https://redwood/INF-3122)

maria: will draft a short RFC addendum and test plan (adapter crash, revoke lost, scheduler restart). feature-flag rollout.
